uncited: **Outputs:** Compressed PlenOctree model (encoded point cloud attributes).
The PlenOctree is represented as a set of octree leaves.
This stores density $\sigma$ and Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients $k$.
Train a NeRF-SH network [6] to output SH coefficients $k$ of degree $\ell_{max}$ instead of RGB colors.
Sample the trained NeRF-SH to extract density $\sigma$ and SH coefficients $k$ into octree leaves.
Estimate opacity $\alpha$ for each node to remove nodes with low influence.
View the octree leaves as a voxelized point cloud $P$ with $N$ voxels.
It incorporates techniques from Mip-NeRF [11] for ray offsets and SNeRG [7] for the Cauchy loss.
